_about: School website links from the Ministry's contact list that no longer work, checked with scripts/check-school-links.mjs and reviewed by hand. dead = the domain no longer exists or the page is gone (404/410); parked = a domain-for-sale page; unrelated = the address now leads to a site that has nothing to do with the school. The site hides these links and says why. Links a site refused to answer for automated checks are never listed. Recheck yearly and drop entries the Ministry has fixed.
